objective: De-risk Visa and Mastercard dispute APIs Adapter, Internal payments ledger API Adapter, Corporate email service Adapter, Redis Cache before Core Build by proving the riskiest requirements against measurable targets.
hypotheses: Visa and Mastercard dispute APIs Adapter can meet its success criteria without changing the Modular Monolith design
Internal payments ledger API Adapter can meet its success criteria without changing the Modular Monolith design
Corporate email service Adapter can meet its success criteria without changing the Modular Monolith design
Redis Cache can meet its success criteria without changing the Modular Monolith design
out_of_scope: Automated dispute decisioning using machine learning.

success_criteria.metric: Portal pages load in under 2 seconds at p95 for 500 concurrent…
success_criteria.target: under 2 seconds at p95; 500 concurrent merchants
success_criteria.measurement: load test with k6 in a production-like environment

success_criteria.metric: 99.9% monthly availability for the merchant portal.
success_criteria.measurement: synthetic probes over a 7-day soak test

success_criteria.target: >= 90% task completion and median time-on-task <= 3 min with 5 target users
success_criteria.measurement: moderated usability test with the product owner

success_criteria.metric: End-to-end round trip with Visa and Mastercard dispute APIs sandbox
success_criteria.target: >= 95% of 50 contract-test cases pass; p95 < 1 s
success_criteria.measurement: contract tests against the sandbox in CI

success_criteria.metric: End-to-end round trip with Internal payments ledger API sandbox
success_criteria.target: >= 95% of 50 contract-test cases pass; p95 < 1 s
success_criteria.measurement: contract tests against the sandbox in CI

success_criteria.metric: End-to-end round trip with Corporate email service sandbox
success_criteria.target: >= 95% of 50 contract-test cases pass; p95 < 1 s
success_criteria.measurement: contract tests against the sandbox in CI

modular_boundaries: PoC code for Visa and Mastercard dispute APIs Adapter sits behind the production interface so it can be hardened, not rewritten
PoC code for Internal payments ledger API Adapter sits behind the production interface so it can be hardened, not rewritten

go_no_go: Go to Core Build if every measurable Must criterion is met; otherwise the Solution Architect revisits the pattern/stack and the EM re-baselines the schedule.
assumptions: NFR-06 quantified conservatively as '>= 90% task completion and median time-on-task <= 3 min with 5 target users' (org default/proxy); confirm with product owner.
